column1: ### Jacob Gibbs 2026 board - the 2026-08-30 republish. Half-PPR redraft, top 200.
### Trevor sent both pages by Telegram on 2026-08-30; the images are kept at
### ../_shots/gibbs-tiers-2026-08-30-p*.jpg and the board exists only as those images.
### THIS IS NOT A BUILD INPUT. jacob-gibbs-2026-08-30.csv is what build_jacob_gibbs.py
### reads. Four readers transcribed the images, two per page, none seeing another's
### output. The CSV took one pass per page; this file is the other. Do not regenerate it
### from the CSV or the test stops being a second opinion.
### PAGE 1 (ranks 1-93): both readers agreed on every field of all 93 rows.
### PAGE 2 (ranks 95-200): the readers disagreed on four cells. Each was settled by
### cropping that row out of the image at 4x and reading it, NOT by preferring a reader.
### The adjudicated value is what this file carries; the losing read is recorded here:
###   rank 97: this reader had IND (5) WR, image shows IND (13) WR
###   rank 101: this reader had MIN (6) WR, image shows MIN (6) RB
###   rank 144: this reader had BAL (13) WR, image shows BAL (13) RB
###   rank 174: this reader had IND (5) QB, image shows IND (13) QB
### TWO DEFECTS ON HIS BOARD, not ours, each confirmed by both readers at 3x zoom:
###   1. Rank 164 is not printed and 165 is printed twice (Malik Davis, then Jauan
###      Jennings). Column order breaks the tie: the first takes 164 and keeps 165 in
###      printed_rank. Nothing is renumbered silently.
###   2. Rank 196 prints 'Fernando Mendoza LV (11)' while every other LV row reads 13,
###      including Michael Mayer directly beneath it. Transcribed as printed.
### RANK 94 IS MISSING FROM BOTH IMAGES. Page 1 closes at 93 (the table border sits
### under it) and page 2 opens at 95, so that row was never captured. The board ships
### with 199 of 200 and this file records the gap rather than inventing a player.
